# 2 Baruch Chapter 45 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Third Fast and Vision

---

**45:1** Think-therefore upon-these-things in-your-hearts and-fix-your-minds upon-the-law — and-wisdom-will-train-you for-your-good.

**45:2** And-I-Baruch say this-unto-you: you-who-are-here, keep-well in-your-hearts all-which-I-have-commanded-you — that-you-may-not-forget it.

**45:3** For-I-know that-the-earth will-surely-change [at that time], and-that-the-heavens will-not-remain-the-same; and-that-the-times will-pass-away; and-that-the-Most-High will-renew-[all]-his-creation.

**45:4** And-those-who-have-been-made-pure-by-wisdom will-be-changed; and-the-appearance-of-their-face will-be-turned into-light-[of-beauty]; and-they-will-be-made-[like]-the-stars.

**45:5** For-that-which-is-written in-the-law will-be-fulfilled; and-all-who-have-not-believed will-not-be-able-to-resist.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac Codex Ambrosianus. Chapter 45 is Baruch's closing exhortation in this section. The promise of transformation (v.4) — faces turned to light, made like stars — is one of the most beautiful resurrection-transformation images in 2 Baruch. The "wisdom" here is closely tied to the law. The chapter closes with the certainty that what is written in the law will be fulfilled.*
